card.name: Periods inside DOI strings
card.fires_on: The period inside a DOI code in a journal citation, especially right after the journal abbreviation (such as pnas, ajhg, science, journal.pone) and before the year or article number.

modes.label: After journal code
modes.description: The dot right after the journal abbreviation in a DOI, before the year or article number.

modes.label: Later dots in DOI
modes.description: A dot between the year and the article number in a DOI.

card.plain: It marks the dot inside a DOI link in a reference list, where a number comes next.
